audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer says 'Pending kit verification profile parameters' where the enemy's key ability should be — in tldr, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].d and report[0]. report[5] tracks an ability literally called 'Ultimate (—)' with no cooldown. Zaahen's kit is now present in the brief, so none of this needs to stay blank.
audit.why: Riot's text gives the whole picture. Passive: attacks and abilities on champions grant Determination stacks for bonus AD, and when filled he gains increased AD and CAN REVIVE. Q (The Darkin Glaive), 10s at rank 1: slashes twice on his next attack and heals him, recastable so the following attack knocks up — and it is an auto-attack reset, so the tell is a wind-up, not a cast. W, 14s at rank 1 at 850 range: stabs then PULLS you toward him — that is his real gap-close onto an immobile Garen. E (Aureate Rush), 10s at rank 1: a dash that slices around himself and deals percent health, so stacking armour is the wrong answer. R (Grim Deliverance), 110s at rank 1: heals for a portion of damage dealt. The revive is the single most important fact for a Garen: it is the one thing that answers a spent Demacian Justice.
audit.corrected: Replace the placeholders with the revive, the Q heal and reset, the W pull, and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says Demacian Justice means 'below threshold he cannot coin-flip you'. Against Zaahen that is not reliably true.
audit.why: His passive lets him revive once Determination is filled. A clean execute on a revive-ready Zaahen does not end the fight, so the level-6 spike has to be read off his stack bar, not just his health bar.
audit.corrected: Tie the execute to checking the Determination bar.

audit.why: The Darkin Glaive is 10s at rank 1 and carries both his heal and his knockup recast; Grim Deliverance is 110s at rank 1. Those are the two clocks worth playing around.

audit.whatIsWrong: First back is Tiamat/Phage with no anti-heal anywhere in the build, in a lane whose own prose says 'he heals off every difference'.
audit.why: Two of his abilities heal — Q on every use at 10s, and R for a portion of damage dealt. missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for exactly these two. Grievous Wounds is the item that makes the extended trade winnable, and it wants to land before his revive threshold matters.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling first back, Mortal Reminder third and framed against the revive timing.
